Bitcoin closes decisively above the eight-figure mark at eighty thousand dollars while institutional ETF inflows sustain momentum for an unprecedented eighth consecutive day with two hundred thirty-two million dollars entering funds today. While dollar liquidity contracts creating a significant headwind for risk assets we must demand more proof on continuation longs given that overbought RSI levels now plague both Solana and Ethereum. The current price action relies heavily on short liquidations driving value higher rather than genuine fundamental buying pressure at these extreme valuations which creates dangerous fragility in the structure of this rally. Fear and Greed sits firmly at seventy-one indicating a state of euphoria that often precedes sharp corrections when supply unlocks or failed breakouts occur to trigger stop hunts. Headlines reinforce this narrative with DeFi Development Corp acquiring nearly twenty thousand SOL and Charles Schwab adding Solana Avalanche and Chainlink to their platforms yet these catalysts may simply fuel the final leg before exhaustion sets in. The tape remains up-trending but traders should treat any failure of price action at current highs as a superior opportunity for short positions rather than fading strength blindly into an overheated market where funding rates are dangerously elevated.

column.text: Bitcoin closes decisively above the eight-figure mark at eighty thousand dollars while institutional ETF inflows sustain momentum for an unprecedented eighth consecutive day with two hundred thirty-two million dollars entering funds today. This rally has fundamentally decoupled from traditional tech, as the correlation between BTC and the NASDAQ approaches zero suggesting this move is driven purely by digital asset liquidity dynamics rather than macro beta exposure. While dollar liquidity contracts creating a significant headwind for risk assets we must demand more proof on continuation longs given that overbought RSI levels now plague both Solana and Ethereum. The current price action relies heavily on short liquidations driving value higher rather than genuine fundamental buying pressure at these extreme valuations which creates dangerous fragility in the structure of this rally. Fear and Greed sits firmly at seventy-one indicating a state of euphoria that often precedes sharp corrections when supply unlocks or failed breakouts occur to trigger stop hunts. Headlines reinforce this narrative with DeFi Development Corp acquiring nearly twenty thousand SOL and Charles Schwab adding Solana Avalanche and Chainlink to their platforms yet these catalysts may simply fuel the final leg before exhaustion sets in. The tape remains up-trending but traders should treat any failure of price action at current highs as a superior opportunity for short positions rather than fading strength blindly into an overheated market where funding rates are dangerously elevated.
